scope: Extensible paired expansion, source references and native ImageGen candidates; no automatic canon, human, runtime or Bible closure

acceptedStructure.originalGenerations: A entries created by ImageGen; source-copy A entries are derived from the source index

bSourceCopyLineage: For nine community references, sourceAPath is production/biomasks-expansion-20261113/references/community/{id}.png
bGeneratedALineage: For neca-kwei-prototype, sourceAPath is the actual public ImageGen A path; its SHA must match the accepted originalGenerations entry

generationReceiptStructure.entries: Entries with matching id and explicit version A or B; actual prompt is required. Both Kwei versions may share the same receipt JSON but require distinct nativeSourcePath and distinct native PNG bytes.

receiptMayUseModeForPixelMode: RGBA denotes native pixels only; renderMode=imagegen denotes the generation decision
communityA: Exact RGB256x257 reference screenshot on black with external dreadlocks; not an alpha cutout or original PHG pixels
prototypeA: New isolated ImageGen mask faithfully matching the photographed NECA prototype; Not Final Product, not a certified film version
allB: New transparent ImageGen mask-only candidates; preserve source-visible design, view and known palette; exclude wearer/dreadlocks/background
